name: Cancelled Status Reason 3 Code
definition: Specifies the underlying reason for cancellation of the associated transaction.

CNTA.name: Cancelled By Transfer Agent
CNTA.definition: Transaction is cancelled by the transfer agent.

CNCL.name: Cancelled By Client
CNCL.definition: Transaction is cancelled by the client.

CNIN.name: Cancelled By Intermediary
CNIN.definition: Transaction is cancelled by the intermediary.
